description: Put 1 to 100 messages (any JSON, up to 64 KB each) in a queue of your durable-queue plan; the queue is made on first use. dedup_key: while a message with it is in the queue, the same key returns that message.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

dedup_key.description: While a message with this key is in the queue (dead letters too), another put with it returns that message (duplicate: true).

delay_seconds.description: 0 to 900 (15 minutes): claimable only after this. Default 0.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

queue.description: Queue name: 1 to 64 characters from a-z 0-9 . _ -.

name: queue_put
title: Put messages in my queue
